data: What is the approximate highest success rate achieved by test imagined?

The caption states that the figure compares the success rates of testing goals of Type 5 (grow + plant) with and without imagination. The blue line represents the success rate for goals that were imagined, while the orange line represents the success rate for goals that were not imagined. The green line represents the no imagination baseline. The caption also mentions that the figure shows the Low Coverage variant of the goal imagination mechanism, which covers 43.7% of the test set with a 45% precision. The question asks for the approximate highest success rate achieved by test imagined. From the figure, we can see that the blue line (Test Imagined) reaches its peak value around 0.65, which is higher than the orange line (Test Not Imagined) and the green line (No Imagination Baseline). Therefore, the approximate highest success rate achieved by test imagined is 0.65.
